h1: SEO and AI visibility for fintech and regtech companies
secondaryKeywords: AI visibility for fintech, content marketing for regtech, fintech SEO agency
contentIdea: Show that Snoika has actually worked inside regulated verticals rather than borrowing generic SaaS playbooks. The argument is that fintech and regtech content carries a compliance review nobody else's content carries, that the buying committee reads differently — risk and legal sit in it, not only marketing — and that this is where Snoika's own client results come from: identity verification, VAT compliance and e-signature companies.
productDescription: Snoika is an AI marketing agency working with regulated B2B companies in fintech, regtech and compliance software. Work runs on a retainer: AI+SEO Lite starts at 2 published articles per week and AI+SEO Pro at 3 per week, both including keyword and prompt research, on-page work and publishing. Add-ons cover programmatic SEO (200-500+ generated pages built around jurisdiction, rule or use case), Reddit organic posting and community strategy, Quora answers, LinkedIn posting at 3-4 posts per week, Trustpilot review generation at 2+ reviews per week, backlink placement on DA 85+ domains, content repurposing and full website rework. Typical timeline: first movement in rankings and LLM mentions in months 1-3, a steady inbound lead flow around months 5-6, full scale at 9-12 months.
clientProof: Source: Snoika internal client reporting. Every figure is measured against that client's own baseline over the stated window. Vespia (identity verification and AML), 180 days: 2-3 inbound leads per day, 220% increase in LLM brand mentions, average keyword position improved by 18 places, 85% traffic growth, 52% form-submission conversion. 1StopVAT (VAT registration and compliance), 16 weeks: ChatGPT visibility from 2.7% to 28.3%, average LLM position from 4.8 to 3.5, traffic up 8.5%. Agrello (digital identity and e-signature), 30 days: 51,800 impressions at an average position of 9.2, sessions up 125.6% year on year. Outside the vertical, for scale: 3DPrinterOS, 180 days, 3-4 qualified inbound leads per day and 185% increase in organic users.
writingPreferences: Address the reader as "you" and assume they run marketing at a regulated financial or compliance software company. Never call Snoika a "solution" or a "platform" — it is an agency. Assume every claim on this page will be read by someone in legal or compliance, so make no promise about outcomes that is not already attached to a named client and a stated window. Reproduce every percentage exactly as supplied and never round it.
